rule: positive candidates {C2,C3,C2&C3} qualify if first-half pooled n>=30 AND fwd20 mean&median both > C0(first-half); pick top<=2 by mean uplift; none qualified.
note: C2/C3 both worse than C0 in exploration -> hypotheses 2/3 not supported in-sample -> 0 positive selected. C1 carried as avoidance test. Second half scores C0 + C1 only.
